Item Content Managed in the Customer ERP
• Central repository in org ERP to manage data for all the materials they use to build their products or to deliver services

• Examples: o A manufacturing company maintains a master list of all the materials necessary to build their products. o A hospital maintains a list of all of the supplies that need to be on hand to run the hospital.
What Item Content Might Be Managed in Customer ERP
• Item master o ID number o Description o Packaging o Images o Manufacturer name and part number o Category/commodity/ accounting codes o Standard price
• Suppliers o Supplier part number o Supplier packaging o Org price/BU price
• Contracts o Supplier o Org/BU price
• Inventory o Quantity o Value o Location o Status
• Some items difficult for shoppers to find
• Some item data is incomplete or out of date
• Buyers spend too much time supporting the procurement process and managing items
Benefits of Bringing Item Master Items into ePro
• Access items in one place for shopping
• Get access to larger supplier network
• Improve catalog management functionality and control and reduce administration time

• Item content is synchronized between ERP and ePro via integration. o This makes all items across both systems available for shopping. o Items can be promoted via supplier-, category-, and item-level preferences.
• Items can be linked automatically with data managed in ePro:
• Item master (list price) item to contracted item
• Item master or contract item to hosted catalog item o This creates a single “virtual item” that consolidates the best item information and pricing from all the source data.
